sources.snippet: FlagOS FlagOS is an open-source AI system software stack for large model training, inference, and deployment, with adaptation support for mainstream frameworks and hardware platforms. Xing4.0 has integrated mHC Triton-Ascend fused operators into MindFormers via FlagOS, with single-node 16-card training validation completed.
